facts.name: Laughing Monk NOPA
facts.label: Laughing Monk
facts.tagline: Laughing Monk Brewing's gastropub on Fulton Street in NOPA, with Chef Reina Montenegro's plant-forward Filipino dishes alongside burgers and flatbreads.
